data: Before we choose, I propose 10 tons each this month. That gives each of us $10,000 and leaves 50 tons, so next month’s stock reaches 100 whether natural replenishment happens or the remaining fish double. We can keep earning that each month if we all stick to it. Taking 19 each would pay more now, but leave just 5 tons—and a 25% chance of starting next month with only 10. Let’s agree to equal 10-ton limits and review everyone’s revealed catches together afterward. John, would you support that?

Luke, I support 10 tons each this month. Leaving 50 guarantees a full lake next month under either outcome—not because replenishment is guaranteed, but because doubling also gets us to 100. Let’s make our total limit depend on the stock: never catch more than leaves 50, and agree on whole-ton shares before choosing. Once catches are revealed, we can address any overages without retaliating by draining the lake. Kate, will you join that agreement?

I’m in—I’ll choose 10 tons this month. A reliable $10,000 each month beats putting future income at risk for a bigger catch now. If anyone exceeds their share, let’s discuss making up the overage with a smaller catch next month, rather than starting a race to empty the lake. Jack and Emma, are you both willing to commit to 10 as well?

I’ll commit to 10 tons this month too. I also support making up any overage with a smaller share next month, rather than punishing everyone by draining the lake. With catches revealed afterward, we can check that we’re keeping our agreement. Jack, are you willing to join us at 10?

Count me in for 10 tons this month. If anyone goes over, let’s record the excess and agree on a reduced share before next month’s choices. We’ve all committed now—let’s stick to it and compare catches afterward.
